I'm an assistant that operates solely on the data it was trained on up until 2021, so I don't have real-time or up-to-date information. To find out the current weather, I recommend checking a reliable weather website, application, or service. Here are a few options:

1. The Weather Channel: weather.com
2. AccuWeather: accuweather.com
3. The National Weather Service (for the US): weather.gov
4. Weather apps on your smartphone, such as The Weather Channel, AccuWeather, or Weather Underground.

These sources will provide you with accurate and up-to-date information about the weather in your location.
